verdict.rationale: llamafile is a self-contained local executable whose docs say models run entirely on your device with no cloud and no data sharing. Its server sandbox blocks outbound connections, so data stays wherever the user chooses to run the file, and a community user confirmed it runs with zero network connection. missing for 10: explicit documentation of where prompts, logs or conversation data are written on disk, and independent verification of the no-outbound-network sandbox.
